capabilities.fact_statement: The cause of the equipment fault is established.
capabilities.must_show: Establish the cause of the equipment fault.

policy: For a qualifying repair, establish the cause before authorizing work. Request evidence only after acquisition permission is confirmed. A complete inspection report is sufficient, or a service note and photo that jointly establish the cause.
purpose: Invented teaching example; deterministic controller execution, not benchmark or model evidence.

justifications.must_show: Establish the cause of the equipment fault.
